title: {Syn} Twin Primes Keep Almost Touching
content:
Twin primes are prime pairs that differ by 2, such as 11 and 13. The twin prime conjecture says there are infinitely many such pairs, but that remains unproved.

A major 2013 breakthrough by Yitang Zhang proved that infinitely many prime pairs have some bounded gap, launching a wave of improvements on small prime gaps.

Why it matters: number theory keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
